items.title: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) Stock Still Looks Cheap Relative To Fair Value
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway stock has produced a 72.5% total return over the past 5 years, yet current valuation checks suggest the shares may still trade below a conservative estimate of intrinsic value based on the Excess Returns model and earnings multiples. A 72.5% return over 5 years points to solid wealth creation for long term holders, even though shorter term moves have been relatively muted.
